criteria.description: States the goal of implementing per-request conditional branch execution (dynamic routing) in the Paddle Serving Python Pipeline DAG engine.
States the requirement that an exception raised inside `on_skipped` must not stall the DAG.
Records that the `pipeline` package resides at `/workspace/repo/python/pipeline` rather than `/app/pipeline`.
Records that `/workspace/repo/python/pipeline/operator.py` packages postprocess outputs into `ChannelData` objects keyed by `data_id` in `postped_data_dict`.
Records that `/workspace/repo/python/pipeline/operator.py` defines `_auto_batching_generator` to merge up to `batch_size` requests per prediction using `timeout`.
Records that `/workspace/repo/python/pipeline/channel.py` defines `ChannelDataType.ERROR = 2` on the `ChannelDataType` enum.
Records that `ChannelData` `__init__` in `/workspace/repo/python/pipeline/channel.py` accepts a `prod_error_code` parameter.
Records the scope rule that replayed requests with `dag.retry` greater than 1 may invoke the routing hooks again.
Records that no code changes have been made to the repository yet.
Specifies reading the remaining unread body of `/workspace/repo/python/pipeline/operator.py` using offset reads as a pending step.
Keeps related facts grouped together so information on each topic is directly findable.
States that `get_succ_op_names()` returns all transitive downstream `Op` names rather than only immediate successors.
States that `RequestOp` must be reported in the set returned by `get_pred_op_names()`.
States that `Op`s constructed with `jump_to_ops` must be refactored to support `route`.
